findings.title: Empty-state em-dash placeholder too small for TV viewing distance
findings.evidence: captures/06-oss-empty-state-public.png — '—' is text-[28px] gray #A0A3BD, while active tokens are text-[56px] (2x). At 3m+ viewing distance from a wall TV, the placeholder visually reads as 'blank screen', which can confuse a customer about whether the system is offline.
findings.recommendation: Either bump empty placeholder to text-[40px]+ (matches header rhythm) OR replace '—' with a localized label like 'Aucune commande en cours' / 'Pas de commande prête' for clearer status semantics. Could keep the gray color for low priority.

findings.title: Public wall has no Echo/WS subscription — exclusively polling
findings.evidence: PreparingAndReadyComponent.subscribeEcho line 260: `if (branchId <= 0) return;` — public wall (authBranchId()=0) skips Echo entirely. Sync relies on OssSyncService polling at 2s cadence when wsState='disconnected'.
findings.explanation: This is by design: Pusher/Echo channels require auth, public wall has no sanctum token. The intervalMsWhenDisconnected=2_000ms tightening (commit referenced as 'test-e2e round-2 cluster-6 D-002 2026-05-10') makes this practically real-time. Wall observed updating ~8s post-DB-change in the empirical test (well within the 8s SYNC-2 budget).
findings.recommendation: Accept as V1 design. Document in BRAIN §3 that public wall sync is polling-only (60/min/IP rate limit is the real ceiling). V1.0.2 could explore presence-channel with an anonymous fan-out token if 2s isn't tight enough.

findings.title: branch_id enumeration is documented backlog but not yet enforced
findings.evidence: RouteServiceProvider.php:236-237 comment: 'Logging of >10 distinct branch_id values from the same IP within 5 min is deferred to V1.0.2 (see plans/v1-0-2 backlog).' — currently only the rate limit (60/min/IP total) is enforced, which an attacker probing for valid branch_ids can comply with by spreading queries.
findings.explanation: On a multi-branch SaaS deployment, attacker can map active branch IDs by observing row-count delta. On the V1 Le Cayenne single-branch deployment this is moot (only branch_id=1 exists). Mentioned as documented V1.0.2 backlog item.
findings.recommendation: Already tracked. V1 GO; no action needed for Le Cayenne single-resto. SaaS V2 must implement the distinct-branch-id sliding-window counter described.

ship_recommendation: GO V1 Le Cayenne — system is production-ready for single-resto V1. F-001 P2 cosmetic (empty-state size) recommended for next cosmetic pass; F-002 and F-003 are documented design choices already tracked in V1.0.2 backlog. No blockers.
